Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick demo — we're ready to move forward for our Q4 rollout. I've attached the signed PO (PO_77291.pdf) and the SOW for reference. Can Redwood produce two invoice lines / two remit instructions so our AP can automate posting to each ledger? Prefer to have both invoices bundled as a single PDF for upload, if that's doable.

Also include net-30 payment terms and please confirm the legal entity names you will invoice so we can match PO fields.

Thanks — elena

Hannah — thanks. Quick answers from finance: we can do two invoices and bundle them into a single PDF for the customer's AP, but we need the following to proceed:

1) Confirm legal entity names and remit addresses to put on each invoice. Our standard is:
   - Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — remits to Redwood US bank (ACH / wire)
   - Redwood Inference Ltd. (Ireland) — remits to Redwood EU bank (SEPA / IBAN)

2) For reverse-charge: we need the customer's EU VAT registration number and a signed statement that ClearHealth EU will self-assess VAT. Without a valid EU VAT ID we must charge VAT on the EU invoice. Please ask the customer to provide a VAT certificate (or VAT number) and we'll include the reverse-charge line on the invoice.

3) PO matching: we'll put the customer's PO number on both invoices; please confirm whether the single PO covers both entities (we can put PO_77291 on both lines).

4) Timeline: if we receive VAT proof and entity confirmation by EOD Thu (2026-11-11 23:59 UTC), we can generate both invoices and the bundled PDF by COB Fri (2026-11-12). Otherwise we'll need an extra business day.

I attached our internal invoice template examples (see reference in our system) — will produce final PDFs once items above are confirmed.

— Marissa (Finance)

Couple of legal/tax notes:

- Confirm Redwood EU legal name: we should use "Redwood Inference Ltd." (Irish entity) on the EU invoice. Use its VAT registration on the invoice footer.
- For reverse-charge to apply, we need ClearHealth EU's VAT ID (format: IE/DE/... depending) and an explicit line referencing Article 196 (or local equivalent) where appropriate. Finance will include the reverse-charge text when VAT ID is provided.
- Procurement: ensure PO has the correct billing address lines for each entity. If procurement insists on a single billing address, we'll still produce two invoices but note that AP reconciliation is on the customer side.
- DocuSign: we should send an updated MPA amendment that lists the billing split to avoid confusion on renewal invoicing. I can prepare a short amendment if needed — share the desired split and I'll attach.

I'll prepare standard wording for the invoice (reverse-charge statement) and share the DocuSign link after Ben confirms the split.

— Karthik (Legal)
